name: gomoku-studio
description: 弈间 · 五子棋桌面应用

scripts.dev: npm run backend:build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/dev.mjs --desktop
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && npm run backend:build
scripts.format: prettier --write src electron scripts tests *.json *.ts index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src electron scripts tests *.json *.ts index.html
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
